metaTitle: Sliding Glass Door Repair Miramar | Heavy and Impact Doors
description: From 1960s east-side sliders to heavy impact panels out west, what sliding glass door repair in Miramar involves and what the city wants on a replacement.
h1: Sliding glass door repair in Miramar
subline: Half of Miramar's homes went up between 1990 and 2009, and the heavier doors in many of them put real load on two small rollers.
answer: Sliding glass door repair in Miramar depends on which end of the city you live in. Older east-side sliders wear out rollers, tracks and latches. Newer western homes may have heavy impact panels that need rollers rated for the weight. A replacement needs a city permit with an HOA affidavit and an HVHZ-approved door.
faqHeading: Questions about Miramar permits and heavy doors
closing: Send photos of both bottom corners of the panel, the track and any label on the glass. Tell us if the door is impact-rated and we'll take it from there.

faqs.q: Why does Miramar make me sign an HOA affidavit if I'm not in an HOA?
faqs.a: Because the city code requires it from every applicant. Under City Code section 22-29(c)(1), you confirm you understand an association may add rules despite a city permit. If your home isn't in one, you initial the statement saying so and the affidavit is still filed.

faqs.q: Does Miramar accept a Florida product approval or only a Miami-Dade NOA?
faqs.a: Either one. Miramar's windows and doors package asks for a current Florida product approval or a Miami-Dade NOA for each new door, with the options circled that match your wind pressures and opening sizes. Because Broward is in the High-Velocity Hurricane Zone, the approval has to cover HVHZ use.

faqs.q: Do impact sliding doors need special rollers?
faqs.a: They need rollers rated for the panel's weight. FGIA's AAMA 906 standard tests roller assemblies at the load their maker rates them for. A light-duty roller under a laminated impact panel wears out early, so match the rating as well as the size.

faqs.q: Can I pull my own door permit in Miramar instead of the contractor?
faqs.a: Only if you aren't hiring one. Miramar's windows and doors package says that if a contractor is hired, the contractor must pull the permit. Owner-builder permits are for residential work only and need photo ID matching the job address, proof of ownership and confirmation of the homestead exemption.

faqs.q: Which wind load chart does Miramar want with a door permit?
faqs.a: The Broward County Fenestration Wind Load Chart, marked for your building's height. Signed and sealed engineering wind load calculations can be used instead. For buildings 30 feet or taller, Broward's rules call for a site-specific design from a Florida engineer or architect.
